_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Lexdale Witch Trials#000.src: See what's going on in the center of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 {p} 중심가에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 확인하세요.

Lexdale Witch Trials#001.src: We have an enemy amongst our own in {p}! This witch's illegal practice of magic threatens us!
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.dst: 우리 {p} 안에 적이 숨어 있었습니다! 이 마녀의 불법 마법이 우리를 위협하고 있습니다!
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#002.src: Ms. Amira's home was found to be plagued by spreading Decay! We must kill the witch to protect our sanctity!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.dst: Amira 씨의 집이 번져 가는 쇠락에 시달리는 게 발견됐습니다! 우리의 신성함을 지키려면 마녀를 처단해야 합니다!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#003.src: WAIT! Let me GO already! I told you what was happening!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.dst: 잠깐! 이거 좀 놔! 무슨 일인지 다 말했잖아!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#004.src: The deceit of your dark magic won't work, Ms. Amira. Go quietly- leave us in peace!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.dst: 당신의 어둠의 마법으로 속이려 해도 소용없습니다, Amira 씨. 조용히 가시오- 우리를 평화롭게 놔두시오!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#005.src: SHUT UP ALREADY! You can't just single people out like this!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.dst: 좀 닥쳐! 이렇게 아무나 콕 집어서 몰아가면 안 되지!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#006.src: Just hear me out for a second! It's not me, something infected my home! That's the reason it was so dark!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.dst: 잠깐만 내 말 좀 들어 봐! 내가 아니라 뭔가가 우리 집을 오염시켰어! 그래서 그렇게 어두웠던 거라고!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#007.src: My basement, some outlandish thing dug into it! Wherever it went, the area withered and decayed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.dst: 우리 집 지하실에 이상한 뭔가가 파고들었어! 그게 지나간 곳마다 시들고 썩어 버렸다고!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#008.src: There's proof in my house that it wasn't me! It's the one that's decayed and barren! You'll see if you LOOK, you gorehound!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.dst: 내가 아니라는 증거가 우리 집에 있어! 썩고 황폐해진 건 그 집이야! 제대로 보기만 하면 알 거야, 이 피에 굶주린 놈아!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#009.src: Quit with the insults! We'll delay for now- If there's no proof of the witch's innocence she will be executed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.dst: 모욕은 그만하시오! 일단 미루겠소- 마녀의 무죄를 증명할 증거가 없으면 처형하겠소!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#010.src: Explore the basement of the decayed and barren house.

Lexdale Witch Trials#011.src: Follow the creature down the tunnels.

Lexdale Witch Trials#012.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#013.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#014.src: ...Further... intruders...? You are not of the worms... the parasites?
Lexdale Witch Trials#014.dst: ...또... 침입자...? 너는 벌레들의... 기생충들의 무리가 아니냐?
Lexdale Witch Trials#014.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#015.src: Another stranger... You must have witnessed the tunnels. They blight the stone, wither the roots, make lifeless the land...
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.dst: 또 다른 이방인... 터널을 보았겠지. 그것들은 돌을 병들게 하고, 뿌리를 시들게 하고, 땅을 죽음으로 물들인다...
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#016.src: And here, we starve in isolation. My people are lost, as the very earth itself warps and shifts.
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.dst: 그리고 여기서 우리는 고립된 채 굶주린다. 대지가 뒤틀리고 움직이니 내 백성은 길을 잃었다.
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#017.src: The water, stagnant and gray. Nothing but those horrid magic scourges, and the worms themselves to sustain ourselves.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.dst: 물은 고여 잿빛이다. 저 끔찍한 마법의 재앙들과 벌레들 말고는 먹을 것이 없다.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#018.src: We cannot escape, for the sun scourges us. There is no place to go, no place to burrow that they do not wait.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.dst: 태양이 우리를 해치니 달아날 수도 없다. 갈 곳도, 그것들이 기다리지 않는 굴도 없다.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#019.src: You... You... You have life. You have a heart, and muscle, and meat... To survive till this torture ends...
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.dst: 너는... 너는... 너에겐 생명이 있다. 심장이, 근육이, 살이 있다... 이 고통이 끝날 때까지 버티려면...
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#022.src: Wait... These earthquakes! IT'S THEM! AGHHHHHHHHHHH!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#022.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#023.src: Dig yourself out of the dirt. Then go after the creature.
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.dst: 흙을 파고 빠져나온 뒤, 그 생물을 쫓아가세요.

Lexdale Witch Trials#024.src: Return to {p} and try to show the mayor the creature at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.dst: {p}(으)로 돌아가 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 시장에게 그 생물을 보여 주세요.

Lexdale Witch Trials#025.src: You're back. Did- Wait, what in the nine hells is THAT?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.dst: 돌아왔군요. 혹시- 잠깐, 대체 저건 뭐요?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#026.src: That! That was the thing in my basement!! I knew that human could find it! Thank you!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.dst: 저거! 저게 우리 집 지하실에 있던 놈이야!! 저 인간이라면 찾아낼 줄 알았어! 고마워!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#027.src: That thing was spreading the decay through my house! It's NOT witches or magic like you suddenly DECIDED one day!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.dst: 저놈이 우리 집에 쇠락을 퍼뜨렸다고! 당신이 어느 날 갑자기 정해 버린 마녀나 마법 따위가 아니라!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#028.src: ...Fine then. This... creature... bug... leach? This whatever- it- is... I'll accept your explanation.
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.dst: ...좋소. 이... 생물... 벌레... 거머리? 이게 뭐든 간에... 그 설명을 받아들이겠소.
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#029.src: Step off the podium, Ms. Amira. You're innocent.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.dst: 연단에서 내려오시오, Amira 씨. 당신은 무죄요.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#030.src: Gah, finally! You're seeing sense! It's almost like something just... took you over one day and never left 'til now!
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.dst: 아, 드디어! 이제야 정신을 차렸네! 마치 뭔가가 어느 날 당신을... 사로잡았다가 지금까지 안 떠난 것 같더라!
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#031.src: ...hm. That... Mmh. Regardless. Human, you've proven yourself to be trustworthy. We'll keep our doors open for you.
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.dst: ...흠. 그건... 음. 어쨌든. 인간이여, 당신은 믿을 만하다는 걸 증명했소. 우리의 문은 늘 열려 있을 것이오.
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#032.src: As for the... THING... Well... I'll be sure to inform the Gavel government.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.dst: 그... 그것에 대해서는... 뭐... Gavel 정부에 꼭 알리겠소.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#000~1.src: You should follow the creature before it gets away!
Lexdale Witch Trials#000~1.dst: 그 생물이 달아나기 전에 쫓아가야 해!
